facts.fact: Medallion Communications, a carrier-neutral data centre operator, set up its Lagos (Victoria Island) interconnect exchange and data centre in December 2006, hosting about 90 carriers, ISPs and content providers, per Tech Africa.
Medallion Communications opened its Abuja data centre in December 2011, per Tech Africa.
